disposition_reason: Cadmium, chromium, copper, nickel and lead were measured by AAS in potato and carrot composites from five Bokkos farms; Tables 1 and 2 report results in mg/L of digest.

study.design: Farm survey: potato and carrot composites with soil from five farms
study.origin: five farms in Bokkos LGA, Plateau State, Nigeria (Kopmardarken, Feret, Murfet, Tangur, Matol)
study.method: Washed, 1% HNO3 rinse, oven-dried 80 °C 72 h, powdered; HNO3/H2SO4/HClO4 digestion at 80 °C; AAS
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or blanks reported
